## Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLT) - Safety Analysis Set



```{r}
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. 读取数据 (对应原 SAS 的 %d_mergesupp 和 merge)
# ==============================================================================
# 根据之前的需求，读取路径假定为 ../data/
ae_raw <- read.csv("../data/ae.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = c("", "NA", ".", "N/A", "NULL"))
suppae_raw <- read.csv("../data/suppae.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = c("", "NA", ".", "N/A", "NULL"))
adsl_raw <- read.csv("../data/adsl_1.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = c("", "NA", ".", "N/A", "NULL"))

# 统一变量名大小写，防止 CSV 名称与 SAS 中不一致
names(ae_raw) <- toupper(str_trim(names(ae_raw)))
names(suppae_raw) <- toupper(str_trim(names(suppae_raw)))
names(adsl_raw) <- toupper(str_trim(names(adsl_raw)))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. 数据处理 (对应 SAS 的 %d_mergesupp 和 DATA dlt 步)
# ==============================================================================

# 2.1 从 SUPPAE 提取 AEDLT, AEONGO 并转化为宽表
suppae_wide <- suppae_raw %>%
  mutate(QNAM = toupper(str_trim(QNAM))) %>%
  filter(QNAM %in% c("AEDLT", "AEONGO")) %>%
  select(USUBJID, IDVAR, IDVARVAL, QNAM, QVAL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(USUBJID, IDVARVAL),
    names_from = QNAM,
    values_from = QVAL
  ) %>%
  # ⚠️ 核心修改点 1：去掉 as.numeric，改为 as.character，统一为字符型
  mutate(IDVARVAL = as.character(str_trim(IDVARVAL)))

# 2.2 将 SUPPAE 合并回 AE，生成 ae_all
ae_all <- ae_raw %>%
  # ⚠️ 核心修改点 2：确保 AE 里的连接键也是字符型，并用 str_trim 去除可能存在的空格
  mutate(AESEQ = as.character(str_trim(AESEQ))) %>%
  left_join(
    suppae_wide,
    by = c("USUBJID", "AESEQ" = "IDVARVAL") 
  )


# 2.3 合并 ADSL，筛选 SAFFL='Y' 并获取治疗组、年龄、性别变量
dlt <- ae_all %>%
  filter(toupper(AEDLT) == "YES") %>%
  # ⚠️ 核心修复：如果 ae_all 里意外包含了 SUBJID，先删除，防止 join 时重名
  select(-any_of("SUBJID")) %>%
  inner_join(
    adsl_raw %>% 
      filter(toupper(SAFFL) == "Y") %>% 
      select(STUDYID, USUBJID, TRT01A, SUBJID, AGE, SEX),
    by = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID")
  )

# 2.4 派生变量 (对应 SAS 的 || 与 strip 拼接)
# 注意：使用 <br> 替代 SAS 中的 ~\n，这样在 HTML 网页中才会正确换行
dlt <- dlt %>%
  mutate(
    DOSE_SUBJ = paste0(str_trim(TRT01A), "/<br>", str_trim(SUBJID)),
    AGE_SEX = paste0(str_trim(AGE), "/", str_trim(SEX)),
    SOCPT = paste0(str_trim(AESOC), "/<br>", str_trim(AEDECOD), "/<br>", str_trim(AETERM)),
    
    STDTCDY = ifelse(
      !is.na(AESTDY),
      paste0(str_trim(AESTDTC), "<br>(", str_trim(AESTDY), ")"),
      str_trim(AESTDTC)
    ),
    
    ENDTCDY = ifelse(
      !is.na(AEENDY),
      paste0(str_trim(AEENDTC), "<br>(", str_trim(AEENDY), ")"),
      str_trim(AEENDTC)
    )
  ) %>%
  # 排序 (对应 proc sort by DOSE_SUBJ AESPID)
  arrange(DOSE_SUBJ, AESPID) %>%
  # 选择最终需要的列
  select(
    DOSE_SUBJ, AGE_SEX, AESPID, SOCPT, STDTCDY, ENDTCDY, 
    AEONGO, AEOUT, AETOXGR, AEREL, AEACN, AESER
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. 生成最终表格
# ==============================================================================

col_labels <- c(
  "Dose Group/<br>Subject ID",
  "Age(Year)/<br>Gender",
  "AE Number",
  "System Organ<br>Class/<br>Preferred<br>Term/<br>Adverse<br>Event<sup>a</sup>",
  "Start Date<br>(Day)",
  "End Date<br>(Day)",
  "Ongoing",
  "Outcome",
  "CTCAE<br>Grade<sup>b</sup>",
  "Relationship<br>to JAB-23E73",
  "Action Taken<br>with JAB-23E73",
  "Serious<br>Events"
)

# 核心判断：如果数据为空，生成一个带有“No data available”的 HTML 表格
if (nrow(dlt) == 0) {
  
  # 创建一个只有一行的数据框
  empty_df <- data.frame(
    Message = "No data available",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 用 kableExtra 渲染这个空表格，它会自动生成 HTML 表格代码
  kbl(empty_df, col.names = NULL, align = "c", booktabs = TRUE) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("condensed"), 
      full_width = FALSE, 
      position = "center"
    ) %>%
    row_spec(1, bold = TRUE) # 把这一行文字加粗
    
} else {
  
  # 有数据时的正常渲染
  dlt %>%
    kable(
      col.names = col_labels,
      escape = FALSE,      
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = ""
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "center",
      font_size = 11
    ) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "1.2in") %>%
    column_spec(4, width = "1.8in") %>%
    column_spec(5:6, width = "1.0in") %>%
    column_spec(10:11, width = "1.5in")
}

```
